purpose: Define the only historical OHLC inputs permitted for formal StockLab backtesting and production prediction.
principle: Historical price availability is not enough. Every row must belong to a dataset/product whose automated use and intended model use are legally established and auditable.

exchange_purchased_history.public_raw_rule: Never commit purchased raw history to the public repository unless the specific purchase/contract explicitly permits redistribution.

requirements: Taiwan exchange redistribution/use rights where applicable

forbidden_sources.exchange_website_scrape: Official website historical query pages are not automatically licensed for bulk automated collection merely because they are publicly viewable.
forbidden_sources.unverified_third_party: No forum, finance portal, search result, copied CSV, unofficial GitHub dataset or undocumented API may fill historical gaps.
forbidden_sources.synthetic_fill: Missing OHLC rows may not be created by interpolation, forward-fill, AI generation or copied prior close.
forbidden_sources.user_screenshot_as_training_data: Screenshots may diagnose a discrepancy but are not a historical model dataset.

price_rules: open/high/low/close must be finite positive numbers
no silent zero for missing price
normalized_row.volume_rule: Volume must be non-negative observed volume; missing volume remains null and blocks models that require it.

TWSE.route: TWSE Data E-Shop / custom historical data request
TWSE.note: Historical/after-hours data are official products; exact commercial/use rights must be reviewed for the purchased product before ingestion.

TPEx.route: TPEx information purchase / post-market data product
TPEx.note: Use the product/contract that explicitly covers the required historical data and intended analytical use.
